knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

Load packages:
```{r}
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
```

Load the claim level file for the original 2177 cohort (mult_ici) & filter to final patient population. The filtered file will have all the ICI claims and summary indicators from the original SAS cleaning script (04_seer_ICI_trt pattern_SK.sas). 
```{r}
getwd()
data <- read_sas("../Data/processed/mult_ici.sas7bdat")
length(unique(data$PATIENT_ID))
pts <- readRDS("../Data/processed/skin_ici_outcomes3.rdS")
pts <- pts %>%
  filter(
    STAGE_GROUP == "Distant"
  )
ptslist <- pts %>% pull(PATIENT_ID)
dta <- data %>% filter(PATIENT_ID %in% ptslist)
length(unique(dta$PATIENT_ID))
```

Explore variables in claim level file.
```{r}
str(dta)
table(dta$total_within_ici_switch_total)
table(dta$ICI_name)
```

Definition 1: Verify same first day claims for IPI + NIVO from SAS code
```{r}
df <- dta
sas_equivalent_dual <- df %>%
  filter(tx_date == first_ici_date) %>%
  group_by(PATIENT_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_unique_ici = n_distinct(ICI_name),
    has_nivo     = any(ICI_name == "NIVOLUMAB"),
    has_ipi      = any(ICI_name == "IPILIMUMAB"),
    all_drugs    = paste(sort(unique(ICI_name)), collapse = " + "),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(sas_dual = n_unique_ici >= 2 & has_nivo & has_ipi)

cat("=== SAS-equivalent dual count ===\n")
sas_equivalent_dual %>% count(sas_dual)

# Compare to your simpler R check (requires ONLY ipi + nivo, n_unique == 2)
cat("\n=== Patients where SAS says dual but R check differs ===\n")
sas_equivalent_dual %>%
  filter(sas_dual == TRUE) %>%
  filter(n_unique_ici != 2 | !has_nivo | !has_ipi) %>%
  select(PATIENT_ID, n_unique_ici, has_nivo, has_ipi, all_drugs)
```

Explore the triple claim individual:
```{r}
# Cross-tab: what drug combos exist among SAS-dual patients
cat("\n=== Drug combinations among SAS dual patients ===\n")
sas_equivalent_dual %>%
  filter(sas_dual == TRUE) %>%
  count(all_drugs, sort = TRUE)
# Identify the triple-claim patient
triple_day0 <- sas_equivalent_dual %>%
  filter(sas_dual == TRUE, n_unique_ici >= 3) %>%
  pull(PATIENT_ID)

cat("=== Triple-claim patient ID ===\n")
triple_day0

# Pull their full claims record
cat("\n=== Full claims record ===\n")
df %>%
  filter(PATIENT_ID == triple_day0) %>%
  select(PATIENT_ID, tx_date, first_ici_date, ICI_name, daysinceindex) %>%
  arrange(tx_date)

```
Definition 2: Ever-exposed to same-day IPI + NIVO
**NOTE: for this population subsets, the total will n≠585, because it is the total of IPI+NIVO and pembor is excluded.
```{r}
same_day_dual <- df %>%
  filter(ICI_name %in% c("IPILIMUMAB", "NIVOLUMAB")) %>%
  group_by(PATIENT_ID, tx_date) %>%
  summarise(
    has_ipi      = any(ICI_name == "IPILIMUMAB"),
    has_nivo     = any(ICI_name == "NIVOLUMAB"),
    is_dual_date = has_ipi & has_nivo,
    .groups      = "drop"
  )

ever_dual <- same_day_dual %>%
  group_by(PATIENT_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    sa1_ever_dual = as.integer(any(is_dual_date)),
    .groups       = "drop"
  )

cat("=== SA1: Ever dual ===\n")
table(ever_dual$sa1_ever_dual)
```
Definition 3: same day IPI + NIVO within first 4 cycles (~90 days)
```{r}
within_4cycles_dual <- df %>%
  filter(ICI_name %in% c("IPILIMUMAB", "NIVOLUMAB")) %>%
  mutate(days_from_index = as.numeric(tx_date - first_ici_date)) %>%
  filter(days_from_index <= 90) %>%
  group_by(PATIENT_ID, tx_date) %>%
  summarise(
    has_ipi      = any(ICI_name == "IPILIMUMAB"),
    has_nivo     = any(ICI_name == "NIVOLUMAB"),
    is_dual_date = has_ipi & has_nivo,
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(PATIENT_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    sa2_dual_within_4cycles = as.integer(any(is_dual_date)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("=== SA2: Dual within 4 cycles (<=90 days) ===\n")
table(within_4cycles_dual$sa2_dual_within_4cycles)
```
Definition 4: Allowing for not the same day, but within the same- first cycle (21 days)
```{r}
sa3_within_1cycle <- df %>%
  filter(ICI_name %in% c("IPILIMUMAB", "NIVOLUMAB")) %>%
  mutate(days_from_index = as.numeric(tx_date - first_ici_date)) %>%
  filter(days_from_index <= 21) %>%
  group_by(PATIENT_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    has_ipi_within_21d     = any(ICI_name == "IPILIMUMAB"),
    has_nivo_within_21d    = any(ICI_name == "NIVOLUMAB"),
    sa3_dual_within_1cycle = as.integer(has_ipi_within_21d & has_nivo_within_21d),
    first_drug             = ICI_name[which.min(days_from_index)],
    .groups                = "drop"
  )

cat("=== SA3: Dual within first cycle (<=21 days) ===\n")
table(sa3_within_1cycle$sa3_dual_within_1cycle)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Consistency check
# ITT is the only definition where triple pt is forced single,
# so SA1-SA3 counts may exceed ITT by 1 due to that patient
# ============================================================
cat("\n=== Superset check ===\n")
cat("ITT dual:              106\n")
cat("SA3 (within 1 cycle): ", sum(sa3_within_1cycle$sa3_dual_within_1cycle), "\n")
cat("SA2 (within 4 cycles):", sum(within_4cycles_dual$sa2_dual_within_4cycles), "\n")
cat("SA1 (ever):           ", sum(ever_dual$sa1_ever_dual), "\n")
```
Add sensitivity exposure definitions to the outcomes file:
```{r}
# First create itt_dual object (missing from your code)
itt_dual <- sas_equivalent_dual %>%
  mutate(itt_dual = case_when(
    n_unique_ici >= 3     ~ 0L,
    has_nivo & has_ipi    ~ 1L,
    TRUE                  ~ 0L
  )) %>%
  select(PATIENT_ID, itt_dual)

# Then merge all definitions
pts_sa <- pts %>%
  left_join(itt_dual,                                                          by = "PATIENT_ID") %>%
  left_join(ever_dual,                                                         by = "PATIENT_ID") %>%
  left_join(within_4cycles_dual,                                               by = "PATIENT_ID") %>%
  left_join(sa3_within_1cycle %>% select(PATIENT_ID, sa3_dual_within_1cycle), by = "PATIENT_ID") %>%
  mutate(across(c(itt_dual, sa1_ever_dual,
                  sa2_dual_within_4cycles,
                  sa3_dual_within_1cycle),
                ~replace_na(as.integer(.), 0L)))

# Quick check
pts_sa %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    itt        = sum(itt_dual),
    sa3_1cycle = sum(sa3_dual_within_1cycle),
    sa2_4cycle = sum(sa2_dual_within_4cycles),
    sa1_ever   = sum(sa1_ever_dual)
  )
```
Create a sensitivity analysis function that uses 07 Utilization2 code:
```{r}
run_sa_model <- function(data, exposure_var, label) {
  
  d <- data %>%
    filter(STAGE_GROUP == "Distant") %>%
    mutate(
      dual = .data[[exposure_var]],
      YEAR_CAT = case_when(
        YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS %in% c("2013", "2014") ~ "2013–2014",
        YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS == "2015"              ~ "2015",
        YEAR_OF_DIAGNOSIS %in% c("2016", "2017", "2018", "2019") ~ "2016+"
      ),
      YEAR_CAT = factor(YEAR_CAT, levels = c("2015", "2013–2014", "2016+"))
    )
  
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s | N = %d (Dual = %d, Single = %d) ===\n",
              label, nrow(d), sum(d$dual == 1), sum(d$dual == 0)))
  
  model <- glm(
    dual ~ YEAR_CAT + age_75_binary + sex_recode + race_binary + 
      radiation_binary + yost_tertile + pre_ici_surg + charlson_recode + 
      autoimmune_recode + braf_recode + time_to_ici + firstline_ici_recode + 
      histo_C + primary_site_group + mets_brain_claims + n_mets_cat,
    data   = d,   # <-- fixed
    family = binomial
  )
  
  results <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      definition  = label,
      sig = case_when(
        p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      ),
      estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)%s", estimate, conf.low, conf.high, sig)
    ) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    select(definition, term, estimate_ci, p.value)
  
  return(results)
}
```


Run the sensitivity model across all four exposure definitions
```{r}
sa_definitions <- list(
  list(var = "itt_dual",                label = "ITT (same-day IPI+NIVO at index)"),
  list(var = "sa3_dual_within_1cycle",  label = "SA1: Within first cycle (≤21 days)"),
  list(var = "sa2_dual_within_4cycles", label = "SA2: Within first 4 cycles (≤90 days)"),
  list(var = "sa1_ever_dual",           label = "SA3: Ever exposed")
)
library(broom)
sa_results <- map(sa_definitions, function(x) {
  run_sa_model(data = pts_sa, exposure_var = x$var, label = x$label)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

Summary table, one row per covariate, one column per definition
```{r}

sa_wide <- sa_results %>%
  select(definition, term, estimate_ci) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = definition, values_from = estimate_ci)

print(sa_wide, n = 100)
sa_results %>% distinct(term) %>% arrange(term) %>% print(n = 100)
```
Clean data format & save to excel:
```{r}

library(openxlsx)
term_labels <- c(
  "YEAR_CAT2013–2014"                        = "Year of diagnosis: 2013–2014",
  "YEAR_CAT2016+"                            = "Year of diagnosis: 2016+",
  "age_75_binary75+"                         = "Age ≥75 years",
  "sex_recodeFemale"                         = "Sex: Female",
  "race_binaryNon-white/Unknown"             = "Race: Non-white/Unknown",
  "radiation_binaryYes"                      = "Radiation: Yes",
  "radiation_binaryMissing"                  = "Radiation: Missing",
  "yost_tertileMiddle SES"                   = "Yost SES: Middle",
  "yost_tertileHigh SES"                     = "Yost SES: High (least deprived)",
  "pre_ici_surgYes"                          = "Prior surgical resection",
  "charlson_recode1"                         = "Charlson: 1",
  "charlson_recode2+"                        = "Charlson: 2+",
  "autoimmune_recodeYes"                     = "Prior autoimmune condition",
  "braf_recodeYes"                           = "BRAF: Mutant",
  "time_to_ici3–12 months"                   = "Time to ICI: 3–12 months",
  "time_to_ici>12 months"                    = "Time to ICI: >12 months",
  "firstline_ici_recodeFirst SACT"           = "First-line ICI (first SACT)",
  "histo_CNon-UV (Acral/Mucosal/Desmo)"      = "Histology: Non-UV (Acral/Mucosal/Desmoplastic)",
  "histo_COther/Unknown"                     = "Histology: Other/Unknown",
  "primary_site_groupExtremity"              = "Primary site: Extremity",
  "primary_site_groupHead/Neck"              = "Primary site: Head/Neck",
  "primary_site_groupNOS"                    = "Primary site: NOS",
  "mets_brain_claimsYes"                     = "Brain metastases (claims-based)",
  "n_mets_cat1"                              = "Number of met sites: 1",
  "n_mets_cat2+"                             = "Number of met sites: 2+"
)



# =============================================================================
# Format sa_wide with labels
# =============================================================================

sa_wide_labeled <- sa_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = coalesce(term_labels[term], term)  # fall back to raw term if no label
  ) %>%
  relocate(Variable) %>%
  select(-term)

# =============================================================================
# Export to Excel with formatting
# =============================================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Sensitivity Analyses")

# Write data
writeData(wb, sheet = 1, sa_wide_labeled, startRow = 2, startCol = 1, rowNames = FALSE)

# Header style
header_style <- createStyle(
  fontName    = "Arial", fontSize = 10, fontColour = "white",
  fgFill      = "#2C3E50", halign = "center", valign = "center",
  textDecoration = "bold", wrapText = TRUE, border = "Bottom",
  borderColour = "white"
)

# Body style
body_style <- createStyle(
  fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10,
  border   = "TopBottomLeftRight", borderColour = "#D3D3D3"
)

# Alternating row shading
shade_style <- createStyle(
  fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, fgFill = "#F5F5F5",
  border   = "TopBottomLeftRight", borderColour = "#D3D3D3"
)

# Apply header style
addStyle(wb, sheet = 1, header_style,
         rows = 2, cols = 1:ncol(sa_wide_labeled), gridExpand = TRUE)

# Apply body + alternating shading
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sa_wide_labeled))) {
  style <- if (i %% 2 == 0) shade_style else body_style
  addStyle(wb, sheet = 1, style,
           rows = i + 2, cols = 1:ncol(sa_wide_labeled), gridExpand = TRUE)
}

# Column widths
setColWidths(wb, sheet = 1, cols = 1, widths = 35)
setColWidths(wb, sheet = 1, cols = 2:ncol(sa_wide_labeled), widths = 28)

# Title row
writeData(wb, sheet = 1,
          "Table: Adjusted Odds Ratios for Dual vs. Single ICI Receipt — Sensitivity Analyses",
          startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
addStyle(wb, sheet = 1,
         createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 11, textDecoration = "bold"),
         rows = 1, cols = 1)

# Footnote
footnote_row <- nrow(sa_wide_labeled) + 4
writeData(wb, sheet = 1,
          "Reference categories: Year 2015; Age <75; Female; White; Charlson 0; BRAF wild-type; Superficial spreading histology; Extremity primary site. aOR = adjusted odds ratio; CI = confidence interval. *p<0.05, **p<0.01, ***p<0.001.",
          startRow = footnote_row, startCol = 1)
addStyle(wb, sheet = 1,
         createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 9, fontColour = "#666666"),
         rows = footnote_row, cols = 1)

#saveWorkbook(wb, "../Plots & Figures/Utilization_sensitivity_aOR_table.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
cat("Saved: ../Plots & Figures/Utilization_sensitivity_aOR_table.xlsx\n")

```
